usedFor: Hostfully holds vacation rental bookings and Sangam CRM holds leads, so “New Booking Inquiry” can feed “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Inquiry” in Hostfully, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: An inquiry is a guest not yet booked, and the action finds the lead by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” in Hostfully fires on every change, so one booking can run “Create Opportunity” more than once.
